results.hypothesis: The feature activates on imperative prohibitions where 'do not' or 'don't' directly precedes a verb telling the reader not to perform an action.
positive_probes: Do not open the sealed envelope.
Don't touch the wet paint.
Do not press the red button.
Don't feed the animals here.
Do not enter the restricted area.
distractor_probes: You should not open the sealed envelope.
Don't be surprised by the ending.
The sign said no touching the paint.

results.hypothesis: The feature detects warning/disclaimer boilerplate that instructs users not to modify generated files or not to rely on certain statements.
positive_probes: Do not edit this file manually; changes will be overwritten.
This generated file should not be modified by hand.
Do not rely on the following statements as legal advice.
Users should not depend on these claims for accuracy.
Warning: do not modify autogenerated files directly.
distractor_probes: Please update this file manually before committing changes.
These statements are reliable according to the latest report.
The generator modifies files automatically during deployment.

results.hypothesis: The feature responds to negated directive phrases addressing the reader in second person, especially constructions like 'don't ask me why' or 'do not edit' that preempt an expected action.
positive_probes: Don't ask me why I changed it.
Do not edit this section yet.
Please don't email me about delays.
Don't tell me how this ends.
Do not interrupt while I'm speaking.
distractor_probes: I wonder why you changed it.
Please edit this section carefully.
You asked me why it changed.

results.hypothesis: Negated direct-address directives: phrases like "do not X" or "don't X" that tell the reader/listener not to perform an action, often in imperative form (e.g. "do not edit", "don't ask me why").
positive_probes: Do not open that locked drawer.
Don't call me after midnight.
Do not interrupt while I'm speaking.
Don't touch the wet paint.
Do not share this password with anyone.
distractor_probes: I don't know why the alarm rang.
Please avoid opening that locked drawer.
Nobody touched the wet paint yesterday.
